source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of monoclonal antibodies as drugs (PDF 212).

blocks.text: Monoclonal antibodies laboratory mein bane molecules hain jo immune system ki jaraseem se larne ki salahiyat barhate hain. Kyunke yeh khaas antigens ko nishana banati hain, is liye cancer, autoimmune bimariyon aur muta'addi bimariyon ke ilaaj mein mo'assar hain. (Yeh hybridoma cells se kaise banti hain, is ka bayan Chapter 21 mein hai.)

blocks.prompt: Monoclonal antibodies se ilaaj hone wali teen qisam ki bimariyan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Cancer, autoimmune bimariyan aur muta'addi bimariyan.

items: Monoclonal antibodies: lab mein bani, antigen-makhsoos; cancer, autoimmune aur muta'addi bimariyon ke liye.
